paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar ben Yishmael. Jerusalem Talmud, Nazir, Sheloshah Minim, halakhah 2: Perugiri of Caesarea says Elazar bei Rabbi Yishmael; Terumot 11:2. Heilprin proposes reading Elazar “like Yishmael,” meaning that he holds Yishmael’s opinion. The checked Nazir has that wording. Terumot preserves it as well as a “bei Rabbi Yishmael” reading in Perigori’s statement. Yet I saw Tosefta, Terumot, chapter 9: terumah wine in fish-brine is forbidden to nonpriests; Elazar bar Yishmael permits. Also end of Beitzah, chapter 3.
